scope_rule: Use Japan-wide IEA and World Bank indicators to describe EV adoption, charging infrastructure context, and logistics maturity.
open_data_strategy: Use IEA EV indicators and World Bank LPI as national background. Do not use Japan-wide values as routing-instance inputs.
known_limitation: Japan-wide EV and logistics indicators do not directly define delivery routes, customer nodes, charging stops, or quantum benchmark size.

scope_rule: Use Tokyo as the representative urban case where OSM, charging-station geodata, e-Stat mesh, GTFS, and city open data can be evaluated at routing-relevant spatial scale.
open_data_strategy: Collect Open Charge Map or other geocoded chargers, OSM road network, e-Stat mesh/population proxy, GTFS availability, and city traffic/open-data availability for Tokyo.
known_limitation: Tokyo is an urban subcase, not a national routing model. Findings should be described as a Japan-contextualized Tokyo case.
